if (e) self.attack(e); else self.hold();

const es=self.enemiesInRange(); es.sort((a,b)=>(a.type==='agent'?-1000:a.hp)-(b.type==='agent'?-1000:b.hp)); const e=es[0]; if(e) self.attack(e); else {const n=self.nearestEnemy(); if(n) self.moveTo(n.x,n.y); else {const b=self.enemyBase(); self.moveTo(b.x,b.y);}}
const es=self.enemiesInRange(); es.sort((a,b)=>a.hp-b.hp); if(es.length) self.attack(es[0]); else self.hold();
const es=self.enemiesInRange(); es.sort((a,b)=>a.hp-b.hp); if(es.length) self.attack(es[0]); else self.hold();

const es=self.nearbyEnemies(); const close=es.filter(e=>e.type==='knight'&&self.distanceTo(e)<=2).sort((a,b)=>self.distanceTo(a)-self.distanceTo(b))[0]; const targets=self.enemiesInRange().sort((a,b)=>{const p=e=>e.hp+(e.type==='worker'?-80:e.type==='ranger'?-40:e.type==='agent'?200:0);return p(a)-p(b)}); if(close) self.flee(close); else if(targets.length) self.attack(targets[0]); else {const e=self.nearestEnemy(); if(e) self.moveTo(e.x,e.y); else {const b=self.enemyBase(); self.moveTo(b.x,b.y);}}
